accounts.owner_or_project: Near One (Near-One/btc-bridge, contract satoshi-bridge built with feature 'bitcoin'); Bitcoin<->NEAR nBTC bridge. Account is a sub-account of bridge.near.
accounts.what_it_does: Bitcoin bridge contract (nBTC mint/burn); on withdrawals and UTXO management it calls v1.signer.sign to get ECDSA signatures for each Bitcoin transaction input.
accounts.target_chain_evidence: Bitcoin. Source: sign_btc_transaction builds payload = PSBT sighash of input i (get_hash_to_sign) and path = vutxo.get_path(); signature is converted via to_btc_signature() (bitcoin::secp256k1::ecdsa::Signature, SIGHASH_ALL). Legacy SignRequest{payload,path,key_version} = ECDSA/secp256k1.

accounts.owner_or_project: Satoshi bridge ecosystem 'satoshi-account' contract (source Near-Bridge-Lab/btc-bridge-contract, private/not accessible); account under ref-labs.near namespace. Exact legal owner (Ref Finance Labs vs Satoshi/Near-Bridge-Lab) NOT confirmed.
accounts.what_it_does: 'satoshi-account' contract: lets nBTC holders control NEAR accounts (CSNA = chain-signature NEAR account) via a BTC key; relayers submit request_sign_near_txs and the contract calls v1.signer.sign to sign NEAR transactions (sign_near_transaction), paying NEAR gas from nBTC.
accounts.target_chain_evidence: NEAR (signing NEAR transactions with a secp256k1 key derived from v1.signer). Evidence from wasm strings: methods sign_near_transaction, request_sign_near_txs, generate_near_signed_transaction, create_csna_and_inner_account, get_chain_signature_near_account_id/_public_key, near_transaction_signature; error text 'csna does not match btc public key', 'Unsupported chain id'. Wasm bundles k256/secp256k1 and mpc_old crypto-shared key derivation (kdf.rs). Not verified per-signature on-chain.
